title: Ken Amada at the school gate

cues.text: In the paved square outside the school, you walk out with Yukari, Fuuka and Akihiko, bags in hand. Junpei skips ahead of you all and stops.
Natsuki runs up to the group. You and Fuuka turn to her.
Fuuka walks over to Natsuki, and the two of them walk off together across the square.
Ikutsuki, the chairman, walks across the square toward you all, a young boy at his side. Everyone turns to them.
